= column-controls(7)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-11-04

== NAME

column-controls - table column controls

== DESCRIPTION

.Literal quote characters
[cols="'1a','2a'"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.Invalid beside valid
[cols="'1a',2a"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.No partial alignment
[cols="junk^a,1"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.No partial multiplier
[cols="2**a,1"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.Full repeated specification
[cols="2*<.>3a,~m"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2* |*Cell 3*
|===

.Alignment defaults
[cols=">.,.^"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.Count shorthand
[cols="2"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.Semicolon records
[cols="1;2"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.Embedded spaces
[cols="1 a, 2 a"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.Empty records
[cols=","]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.Unknown style
[cols="1z,2"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.Zero repetition
[cols="0*a,1"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.Percentage widths
[cols="25%,75%"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.Unicode junk
[cols="é^a,1"]
|===
|*Cell 1* |*Cell 2*
|===

.Syntactic outer quotes
[cols='1a,2a']
|===
|*First* |*Second*
|===
